LanguageData.DMS_Army.label: Colonial Fleet Security
LanguageData.DMS_Army.description: A group of organized mercenaries whose core members are mostly retired officers of the colonial fleet or amateur militiamen who failed the army physical. As long as the pay is good they hardly care what the job is - anything from cargo escort to clearing insect hives to shooting it out with guerrillas. And if you can cover the expense, they don't mind borrowing some heavy weapons from the army either.
